_missing.runtimeVerification: All14 descriptor identities have device observations. verified=false reserves full feature-hook approval; core Overview UI and owned settings write/readback/restart have separate capability evidence. Probes never evaluated accessors; UI lazy getters were evaluated only after navigation readiness. No store/send methods were called; unimplemented feature contracts and fault durability remain unverified.
_missing.rnInitTiming: 244 is the side-effect module initializing/registering RN AppRegistry, not implementation 245 or app entry 0. Factory completion alone has NOT been shown to be a safe gate for arbitrary eager imports; test actual boot ordering/reentrancy.
_missing.settingsSectionInsertion: Core UI instead wraps only18400.default before its consumer, preserving the original element and presenting a native Modal. No frozen registry replacement/shared memo invocation/new route. UI display, original retention/back and compact persistence were device-tested. Direct registry extension remains unverified and is not required by this implementation.
_missing.fileStorageContract: DEX static contract now traced: documents=getFilesDir, readFile(absolutePath,encoding), writeFile(storageDir,relativePath,data,encoding); readAsset exists in native spec but is not used for settings. See docs/STORAGE-RESEARCH.md. Native rename result is discarded; readback establishes only final content. fileExists false may also mean inaccessible. Native descriptors, private root, schema2 write/readback and cold-restart restoration were verified for the owned settings path on the test device. Native disk-full/power-loss behavior, multiwriter safety and durability are not guaranteed. Load/save failures have isolated unit-test coverage.
_missing.presenceReturnShape: No direct getClientStatus consumer found by exact indexed search. It is a prototype method of default store, not a named export; desktop/mobile/web/embedded keys and subscription API are not runtime checked.
_missing.sendMessageContract: Export and external consumer traced; full async implementation, argument contract and send semantics not audited. Do not call during research.
_missing.deferred: Fake Nitro, platform UI, analytics and other feature hooks intentionally outside this prerequisite research.
